title: Greet and say goodbye in the user's language
body:
## Status
Ready for /harness:work.

## Problem
`greet.sh` and `farewell.sh` only speak English (`greet.sh:3`, `farewell.sh:4`). Users in Germany and France want `Hallo, Ada!` / `Bonjour, Ada !` and the matching goodbyes. There is no way to pick a language today, and no config file at all.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A user picks the language once, in a new config file `~/.config/greet/config` (e.g. `lang=de`); both scripts read it.
- [ ] `en`, `de` and `fr` are supported for both scripts; an unknown or missing language falls back to English.
- [ ] Existing output for English users does not change.
- [ ] `tests/greet.sh` and `tests/farewell.sh` cover each language and the fallback.

## Touches
greet.sh
farewell.sh
tests/greet.sh
tests/farewell.sh
README.md
